description: Get structured metadata for any country or all countries from the GeoNames database. Returns country code (ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3/numeric), capital, continent, official languages, population, area in km², currency code, postal code format/regex, geoname_id, and a bounding box (north/south/east/west lat-lng). Omit country to retrieve all 250 countries in a single response. Supports localized country names via lang parameter. CC BY 4.0 open data, no upstream cost.

country.description: ISO-3166 2-letter country code (e.g. "US", "DE", "JP"). Omit to retrieve all countries.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for localized country names (e.g. "en", "fr", "es")

name: geonames.country.info

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: GeoNames Country Info
